annotations.title: Stored answer for one domain name

description: The stored answer for one domain name: status, drop day, price today, registry facts, word facts and similar sales. Use it when someone asks about one specific domain name: whether it is open or for sale, what it costs, when it drops. Stored data as of its day, not a live reading. Pass `name` (such as get.plumbing).

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: id, name, ending, tracked, status, lifecycle, drop, ownableNow, price, registry, parking, length, format, shape, word, rating, verdict, value, comps.

name.description: A full domain name on an ending the catalog holds, lowercased, IDN as punycode. A bare word, a subdomain, an e-mail address or an unknown ending answers 400 `validation_failed` with `reason` and `suggestion`.
